confidence_notes: Restaurant and coffee anchors rest on aggregator data with small samples (Expatistan, plus a Numbeo-derived comparison site), so they are moderately reliable. Wine and cocktail are weaker: sources conflict widely (bar guides vs. forum reports), so cocktail uses a beer-relative basis (about 1.8x the beer anchor) and wine uses a restaurant-table midpoint. Accommodation is a holistic model estimate for July high season and was not checked against live listings. The FX observation was taken from search-result text describing the RBA exchange rates page; I did not open the RBA page directly. The EUR-to-USD conversion is an assumed rate of about 1.16, implied by snippet data that ranged from about 1.12 to 1.18.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city was used. Restaurant and drink anchors come from Rome-specific cost-of-living aggregators and are converted from EUR. Accommodation is a holistic estimate for a major Italian capital in July peak season, based on general knowledge and the supplied city context.
